## For members

To propose a publication, send the coordinator the DOI (or the full reference and an open-access version) and a sentence on how it relates to the network’s research lines. Only work connected to the network’s themes is listed. Please use the affiliation “Human- and Society-Centered AI Research Network, University of Pannonia” alongside your home unit.
